issues.explanation: Trait does not exist at that namespace; must be Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory as in User.php, otherwise Entity cannot boot.
Same wrong HasFactory namespace import, so EntityMembership cannot use HasFactory.
File does not import App\Models\Entity so Entity::factory() resolves to Database\Factories\Entity which does not exist and the factory fatals.
Chaining unique() then index() with the same name creates two indexes with name entities_slug_unique and the migration fails; should be unique('entities_slug_unique') alone.
Task requires updating docs/database-schema.md to remove owner_membership_id FK, but the diff touches no docs file.
Diff adds models, policies, factories and migrations but ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests.
TDD convention requires every feature to ship with a test written first; none are present.
Task requires a stored generated column but generatedAs() does not declare stored, so it may create a virtual column instead of stored.
UserRole is imported twice on consecutive lines.
Auth facade is imported but never used in the model.
Type-hinted User is never null so the comparison is always true; just return true.
Migrations use named classes without void return types instead of the artisan anonymous-class stub with up(): void / down(): void.

conventions.evidence: No tests violates TDD; docs/database-schema.md not synced; Entity.php:13 and EntityMembership.php:55 use wrong HasFactory namespace vs User.php:7; migrations use named classes without : void

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:24-42 and app/Policies/* are small and clearly named; dead code: duplicate `use App\Models\UserRole;` at EntityMembership.php:59-60 and unused `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;` at EntityMembership.php:56

requirements.evidence: Models, enum, policies and User::membershipFor structurally present (Entity.php:39-42, UserRole.php:14-18, EntityPolicy.php:230-249); but Entity.php:13 and EntityMembership.php:55 import non-existent HasFactory, EntityMembershipFactory.php:299 misses Entity import, entities migration :345 duplicates unique+index name, docs/database-schema.md missing, owner_seq not declared stored

scope.evidence: All hunks (Entity, EntityMembership, UserRole, User methods, both policies, both factories, both migrations) serve the task; no routes, pages, or unrelated refactors

security.evidence: EntityPolicy.php:230-249 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:171-207 enforce member/owner/admin checks including never-deleting-owner; $fillable set in Entity.php:19-22 and EntityMembership.php:66-70; no Livewire or unescaped output in scope

simplicity.evidence: Lean Eloquent relations/scopes/policies reusing memberships() queries; only duplication is the double UserRole import and verbose policy lookups

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ or test files, only app/Models, app/Policies, database/factories and database/migrations hunks

review.summary: Change structurally covers entities, memberships, roles and policies but cannot run: wrong HasFactory namespace, missing Entity import in the factory, and a duplicate slug index name break boot/factory/migrate, plus required docs update and all tests are missing. For those load-bearing defects it needs substantial rework before merge.
